working_directory_requirement: Run from directory containing script; input paths may be any supplied current files
measurement_method: os.wait4 child process maximum RSS; wall clock includes interpreter startup, reads, validation, sales preparation, aggregation, inference, ordering, write and process shutdown
instrumentation_retry: An initial /usr/bin/time -l attempt produced the correct CSV but resource reporting failed on sandbox-denied sysctl. Repeated same command with wait4; no forecast or source changes.

output_agreement.comparison: Expected output constructed in comparison.py using frozen selected method

cost: No paid model service required; local computer, electricity or hosting costs remain. No dollar estimate without actual rates. AI-assisted analysis/build costs separate; usage and applicable pricing unavailable.
memory_limits: Single-process measured peak resident memory, not hardware RAM measurement or whole-system memory; includes fitting/aggregation and inference. Data and workload as supplied; future growth may increase usage.
fit_inference: Selected pooling method has no iterative learned-model fit. Trailing-90-day local/product/store sufficient statistics form the fitted rates, followed by 336 shrinkage predictions. Entire preparation, rate construction and inference bounded by observed process peak and total time; internal phase timings recorded in computational_profile.json.
